&ACCESS RVP
DEF cell( )


  ;FOLD INIT
    DECL CHAR DMY[3]
    DMY[]="---"
    ;init_io()
  ;ENDFOLD (INIT)
  INIT_IO()
  ;FOLD BASISTECH INI
    GLOBAL INTERRUPT DECL 3 WHEN $STOPMESS==TRUE DO IR_STOPM ( )
    INTERRUPT ON 3
    BAS (#INITMOV,0 )
  ;ENDFOLD (BASISTECH INI)
  Check_Home()

  LOOP
    P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_GET,DMY[],0 )

    SWITCH  PGNO ; Select with Programnumber

    CASE 101,201,301,401
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      Dis_Parca_Alma()

    CASE 102,202,302,402
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      Dis_Parca_Birakma()

    CASE 103,203,303,403
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      Ic_Parca_Alma ()

    CASE 104,204,304,404
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      Kurleme()

    CASE 105,205,305,405
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      ;Camera_Control()

    CASE 106,206,306,406
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      Ic_Parca_Birakma()

    CASE 107,207,307,407
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      NOK_Parca_Birakma()

    CASE 108,208,308,408
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      Final_Parca_Alma()

    CASE 109,209,309,409
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      Final_Parca_Birakma()

    CASE 31

      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_ACKN,DMY[],0 ) ; Reset Progr.No.-Request

      TOOL_CHANGER()


    DEFAULT
      P00 (#EXT_PGNO,#PGNO_FAULT,DMY[],0 )
    ENDSWITCH
  ENDLOOP
END
